# Phase 3 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

**Scope note:** This phase gives stewards the member lifecycle: create, reset, disable, delete, see signed-in sessions and read the loan log. It extends phases 1 and 2 and adds no tokens.

---

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn — already initialized (`components.json`) |
| Preset | `k7Tmw2Qe9x` — **locked**; style `base-linden`, base color `stone`. |
| Component library | `@base-ui/react` primitives |
| Icon library | `lucide-react` |
| Font | `Space Grotesk` — `--font-sans`; `JetBrains Mono` — `--font-heading`. |

---

## Page Layout — `/stewards/{id}`

A single column: the account block, then the sessions block, then a danger block at the foot. The danger block is the only place a delete lives.

## Color

| Role | Value | Usage |

**Accent (`--primary`) reserved for:**

**Destructive (`--destructive`) reserved for:**
1. The delete button and its dialog
2. The disabled-account alert on `/sign-in`

---

## Account Lifecycle Contract (ADMN-01 / ADMN-02)

### Create-member dialog (D-01, D-02)

Name, display name and a generated temporary password shown once, with a copy button.

### Reset-password dialog (D-03)

Confirms, then shows a new temporary password once.

---

## Account Status Contract (ADMN-03)

### Account block layout

A status line, a disable or enable button and the last sign-in time.

### Disable confirmation

Names the member and says their sessions end at once.

---

## Session Visibility Contract (ADMN-05)

### Sessions block layout

A list of signed-in sessions with device, first seen and last seen, and an end button per row.

---

## Delete Contract (ADMN-04)

### Danger block layout

A red-bordered block with one `Delete member` button.

### Delete confirmation

The member must type their name to enable the button.

---

## Lockout & Refusal Contract (D-11 / D-12)

A steward cannot disable or delete the last steward; the button is present and the refusal explains why.

---

## Login Contract (D-07)

A disabled account sees one alert on `/sign-in` and nothing that says whether the password was right.

---

## Loan Log Contract (ADMN-06)

### The Detail column

Shows the shed and tool, with an em-dash when a field does not apply.

### The Members filter tab

A tab beside the existing filters that narrows the log to account events.

---

## Copywriting Contract

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Create button | **"Create member"** |
| Reset button | **"Reset password"** |
| Disable button | **"Disable account"** |
| Delete button | **"Delete member"** |
| Disabled alert | **"This account is turned off. Ask a steward."** |
| Empty sessions | **"Not signed in anywhere"** |

## UI Considerations

Generated by `ui-consideration-probe.cjs` against five surfaces: **E1** create-member dialog, **E2** reset-password dialog, **E3** the account status control, **E4** the sessions block, **E5** the loan log's Members tab.

**35 applicable considerations: 29 resolved (explicit), 3 resolved (backstop), 3 dismissed, 0 unresolved.**

**Element kinds** — probe-detected, operator-confirmed:

| Element | Kinds |
|---------|-------|
| E1 create-member dialog | `form`, `interactive-control`, `static-content` |
| E2 reset-password dialog | `form`, `interactive-control` |
| E3 account status control | `interactive-control`, `static-content` |
| E4 sessions block | `list-collection` |
| E5 loan log Members tab | `list-collection`, `nav` |

> E2's `form` kind was confirmed on purpose: the dialog has no typed input, but it confirms an action, so the form-state categories apply and resolve by reference to the create dialog.

Empty-state and error-state **copy** lives in **Copywriting Contract**; the rows below point at it.

### E1 — Create-member dialog (`form`, `interactive-control`, `static-content`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Fields blank on open, button disabled. |
| loading | ✅ covered | The button spins while the request is pending. |
| error | ✅ covered | A taken name shows an inline message under the field. |
| populated | ✅ covered | The temporary password shows once with a copy button. |
| partial | ✅ covered | A name with no display name is allowed. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Length caps on both fields. |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | A long display name must not widen the dialog. **Verification: backstop** — try 120 characters. |
| zero-one-many | ⊘ dismissed | Two fixed fields. |

### E2 — Reset-password dialog (`form`, `interactive-control`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Opens with the member's name only. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Same spinner rule as E1. |
| error | ✅ covered | A failed reset leaves the old password and says so. |
| populated | ✅ covered | The new temporary password shows once. |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The password sits on one scrolling line. |
| long-text | ⊘ dismissed | Fixed copy only. |

### E3 — Account status control (`interactive-control`, `static-content`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | A never-signed-in member reads "No sign-in yet". |
| error | ✅ covered | A refused change explains the last-steward rule. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Status line plus one button. |
| loading | ✅ covered | The button disables while pending. |
| long-text | ⊘ dismissed | Status text is a fixed set. |

### E4 — Sessions block (`list-collection`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | The empty-sessions copy. |
| loading | ✅ covered | Skeleton rows. |
| error | ✅ covered | An alert with a retry. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Device, first seen, last seen and an end button. |
| partial | ✅ covered | An unknown device reads "Unknown device". |
| overflow | ✅ covered | The list scrolls past eight rows. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | One session hides the end-all button. |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Device names truncate with a title. |

### E5 — Loan log Members tab (`list-collection`, `nav`)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | "No account events yet". |
| loading | ✅ covered | Skeleton rows keep the five-column shape. |
| error | ✅ covered | Alert with a retry. |
| populated | ✅ covered | Five columns, newest first. |
| partial | ✅ covered | An em-dash marks a column that does not apply. |
| overflow | 🧪 backstop | The table must scroll inside its wrapper. **Verification: backstop** — try a 300-character tool name. |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | Zero filter results read differently from no events at all. |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | Long names must keep all columns readable. **Verification: backstop** — same check as overflow. |
